name: [🌸] Flower Incremental
desc:
A game about growing and cutting flowers!
More flowers means more upgrades, and more upgrades means more flowers!

[🪚] Cut flowers with your powerful decimator!
[💪] Buy powerful upgrades to boost your flowers!
[🏝️] And unlock tons of new areas!

[👍] If you are having fun, then like and favorite the game! It means a lot! ♥️

[🛠️] Created by @MegacraftBuilder & JABLENO
